intro: This is Common Ground: one hub to learn the land, plan a plot, and grow it together.
e1: Explore starts in Oakland, with four illustrated places that teach soil, water, and shade.
e2: Zoom out, and the map opens up to thirty-five real farms and gardens across nine counties.
e3: Turn on a climate layer to see where summers run hot.
p1: Next, plan your plot. Start with the site: type a place,
p2: and the planner pulls five years of local weather, frost dates, and a site score.
p3: Then lay out a bed. Guild health scores how well the plants help each other.
a1: Organizers sign in to Canopy, the volunteer dashboard.
a2: The overview shows program health at a glance: active volunteers, show rate, retention, and hours.
a3: To manage volunteers, filter to the people at risk of drifting away, select them, and draft a check-in.
a4: The market funnel shows where people drop off. The biggest leak is between welcome and first visit.
a5: And in Partners, every group has a next play. Open one, and Canopy drafts the outreach message for you.
outro: Common Ground. Explore, plan, and grow together.
